name: Shadowfang Keep loot scales up to a level-60 looter whatever their open-world switch (#211)
contract: #211: a level-60 character saw item level 15 loot in Shadowfang Keep while the mobs scaled to
the character's level. Shadowfang Keep is LFGDungeons.dbc id 8 (map 33), in DEFAULT_SCALING_DUNGEONS
(modules/mod-destiny-weaver/src/destiny_weaver_scaling.cpp), so creatures scale for everyone inside
and dungeon loot scales for everyone inside it whatever their or their leader's open-world switch
Voone 9237 drops Flightblade Throwing Axe 28972 (blue, authored item level 57, required level 55, 5
stamina, 8 attack power) at 100% as the controlled fixture; the client's item key for level 60 is
60 + 5 = 65, and its ItemStat.dbc row at 65 requires level 60. A level-60 looter with the open-world
scaling switch off must loot the axe at scaling level 65 and required level 60, not the authored

steps.label: The corpse holds the authored Flightblade Throwing Axe
DISCRIMINATING: the authored item-level-57 axe scales up to the client key 65 for the level-60 looter
The axe requires the row's level 60 instead of 55
